text: It importeth more then any thyng, to have the souldiours to know how to set themselves in araie quickly... for asmoche as the souldiours, whiche can doe this well, be expert souldiours, and although thei have never seen enemies in the face, thei maie be called old souldiours, and contrariwise, those whiche cannot keepe these orders, though thei have been in a thousande warres, thei ought alwaies to be reputed new souldiours.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
speaker: Fabrizio Colonna
